children: may test a resistance at $97.95 per barrel, a break above which could lead to a gain to $102.62.

The contract has broken above the upper trendline of a  wedge and a resistance at $94.18. The wedge indicates a target around $117. Wave pattern and a Fibonacci projection analysis suggest a more realistic target range of $97.95-$102.62.
Signals will become mixed once the market falls into the range of $90.41-$94.18, as such a fall would signal a false break above $94.18 and the upper trendline of the wedge.
On the hourly chart, the market is recovering from a drop to the previous trading session's low of $93.51. The drop was driven by a wave 4, which is expected to be reversed by the current wave 5.
Immediate support is at $94.53, a break below which may trigger a fall into the $93.55-$93.97 range.
